dedupe_keys.name: wpuq load profile processing and visualisation code

description: The WPuQ GitHub repository contains code for handling and visualising the household electricity and heat-pump measurements published in Zenodo. Its README describes download, processing and validation steps for the project files. A modeller can inspect the workflow before using load profiles in building or distribution-network studies and adapt the routines to select a suitable temporal aggregation. The code does not make the participating houses representative of all heating systems, and scripts may rely on the Zenodo file layout and software versions. GitHub reports BSD-3-Clause for the repository. I read the own metadata and README without cloning code or processing any household data. The related WPuQ data archive is a separate G1 item with CC BY 4.0 rights. No exact catalogue software record was found. Its processed series can support grid simulation of household heat-pump demand after local representativeness checks.
